fusions.name: Hoofbeat
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Cresting Charge
fusions.desc: A charging blow that deals 38 damage, up to 2.2 times as much at maximum range. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Cavalry Surge
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 30% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Gallop Rhythm
fusions.desc: Every 8 tiles you cover, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
